name: Celebrating
overview: Scripture acknowledges that there is a proper time for every activity under heaven, including times of celebration, as stated in Ecclesiastes 3:1. Celebrating rightly involves praising God with heartfelt worship, as encouraged in Psalms 150:1, which calls believers to praise the Lord in His sanctuary and power. At the same time, Colossians 2:16 warns against allowing others to judge us regarding observances such as holidays or special days, emphasizing freedom in Christ while maintaining a focus on honoring God rather than merely following external traditions. Thus, biblical celebration is centered on glorifying God within the appointed seasons and with discernment about which celebrations align with His truth.
